responsibility: Defines the placeholder DFA scheduler model for the rs6000 backend’s synthetic "future" processor target. Cloned from the POWER9 scheduling description, it declares the future CPU’s dispatch, load/store, vector-scalar, branch, crypto, decimal, and non-pipelined divide resources and maps rs6000 instruction type attributes onto reservation, latency, and bypass rules for scalar integer, FP/VSX, vector, HTM, crypto, and quad-precision operations, so GCC’s RTL scheduler can tune instruction ordering for -mcpu=future until a real microarchitecture-specific model is supplied.
